channel.title: Small Space Garden
channel.description: Growing plants on balconies, windowsills and tiny yards.

item.title: How Much Sun Does a Balcony Vegetable Garden Need?
item.description: Extension sunlight guidelines for leafy, root, and fruiting vegetables, how to measure the sun your balcony gets, and what to grow at each level.

item.title: How to Grow Tomatoes in Containers on a Balcony or Patio
item.description: Extension guidance on picking determinate vs indeterminate tomatoes for pots, mixing and feeding the soil, and preventing blossom end rot in containers.

item.title: Choosing Container Size, How Pot Volume Shapes Root Growth
item.description: University extension container volume guidelines for common vegetables and herbs, and why a container that's too small limits growth more than light or water.

item.title: Herbs That Survive a Small Balcony
item.description: University extension guidance on which herbs actually thrive in containers, plus the drainage and sizing details that determine success.

item.title: Seed Starting Indoors, a Timeline You Can Actually Follow
item.description: A university extension-backed guide to starting vegetable and flower seeds indoors, including why a windowsill is the wrong place to do it.

item.title: Watering Mistakes Worth Avoiding
item.description: University extension guidance on the most common container watering errors, including how to tell overwatering apart from underwatering.
